verses.1: The righteous has been lost, and there is no one who will stand by them. The people of kindness are gathered together, but it’s unclear why they are gathered together because of evil.
verses.2: Peace will come, and they will lie down on their beds. They will be there with us.
verses.3: And you, children of heaven, are like beautiful seeds that have been sown. They will grow and flourish.
verses.4: For whom will they rejoice? For whom will they prolong their lives? You children of sin and falsehood!
verses.5: The flames burn under all those trees; they also burn in the streams, beneath the rocks.
verses.6: In the parts of the river, your portion is theirs. They are also your heritage. You have poured out your offerings upon them. These are the ones who receive your gifts.
verses.7: On the hill, she was lifted from her bed. There, she went to offer sacrifices.
verses.8: And after the door and the gate, remember that from there you were taken away. You were raised up from your bed, and you were separated from them. You loved their love, their hands.
verses.9: I obeyed the king’s commands. I carried out his orders, and I sent my enemies far away from here. I scattered them across various places.
verses.10: In many of your paths, you’ve suffered. You never said “no.” Your hands found a way to get through those hardships. So, you didn’t suffer at all.
verses.11: And who can help you? I am afraid that you will be deceived. You haven’t remembered me at all. I am a being from the world of spirits, and you shouldn’t be afraid of me.
verses.12: I will declare your righteousness and your deeds. They will not harm you in any way.
verses.13: In your cries, you will be saved. Your people will be gathered together. The spirit will take them away; the darkness will cover them. The land will be given to them, and they will inherit the holy mountain.
verses.14: And Solu-Solu said, “Go along the path. Take them away from here, from among my people.”
verses.15: For as Ram said, “Let them be raised up to the Holy Name of Marom and Kadosh Eshkohn. Let they be freed from their sorrow and despair, so that they may live in a state of sorrow and sadness.”
verses.16: For I will not fight forever, nor will I endure forever. For the spirit before me is powerful, and I have created souls.
verses.17: In my anger, I became impatient and rushed into the darkness. I was furious, and he went back along the path of his heart.
verses.18: I have seen his ways; I will comfort him and console him. I will heal his wounds and bring peace to both him and his friends.
verses.19: He creates lips that are peaceful and soothing, for both those who are far away and those who are close by. Thus says the LORD: “He will heal them.”
verses.20: And the wicked will be swept away like waves; they cannot stay in their own waters. Their hearts and souls will be swept away from their bodies.
verses.21: There is no peace for the wicked, said God.
